topology.notes: Small ESM package exporting terminal styling APIs from source/index.js with vendored ansi-styles and supports-color helpers.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Cold-start orientation and repo map
evidence: readme.md documents package purpose, install, usage, API, supported color controls, and examples.
contributing.md only points to code of conduct and does not describe local development.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Product usage is excellent, but contributor boot/setup guidance is sparse.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Setup and environment contract
evidence: package.json declares Node engine range and devDependencies.
.github/workflows/main.yml shows npm install followed by npm test.
.npmrc sets package-lock=false.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: The runtime and dependency manager are discoverable, but there is no explicit local setup/doctor contract or lockfile.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Locality of infrastructure and external dependency exposure
evidence: No database, cache, queue, service, or secret-backed runtime dependency was detected.
Tests import local source and use local Node subprocess fixtures.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Local proof is not blocked by remote infrastructure after npm dependencies are installed.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Harness front door and command discoverability
evidence: package.json scripts expose `test` and `bench`.
No Makefile, justfile, taskfile, or .harness front door exists before adoption.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Commands are discoverable through npm but not consolidated behind an engineering harness yet.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Boot and health/readiness path
evidence: Library topology has no service boot requirement.
`npm test` is the practical readiness lane for source, types, lint, and coverage.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: There is no separate doctor/health command; boot should honestly map to dependency presence plus the validation lane.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Seed, fixture, reset, and cleanup state
evidence: test/_fixture.js provides a subprocess fixture for color support behavior.
Tests explicitly set and restore chalk.level in several cases.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Persistent state is not relevant, but terminal/color state and subprocess behavior have lightweight fixtures.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Supported interaction surfaces
evidence: readme.md documents the public import/API surface.
test/*.js exercise the public Chalk API and examples exercise package usage.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: A fresh agent can exercise behavior through the exported library API.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Existing deterministic back-pressure sensors
evidence: `npm test` runs xo, c8 ava, and tsd.
.github/workflows/main.yml runs npm test across three Node versions.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Static lint, unit tests, coverage instrumentation, and type definition checks are already encoded.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Observability and evidence artifacts
evidence: c8 is configured with text and lcov reporters.
AVA output and npm exit status provide deterministic verdicts.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: Evidence exists but is not exposed as a harness-native JSON proof bundle.

axis_a_operate_today.name: Compounding harness loop
evidence: No .harness governance, records, retro flow, or encoded improvement loop was present before adoption.
axis_a_operate_today.notes: The repo has no harness feedback loop yet.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Structural coupling and blast radius
evidence: Core source is split between source/index.js, source/utilities.js, and vendored support modules.
Public exports are centralized in source/index.js.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: Small module count and clear package boundary keep blast radius tractable.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Temporal/change coupling
evidence: The clone is shallow and deep git-history mining was not run.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: Temporal coupling cannot be assessed confidently from the available shallow history.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Cohesion and locality of change
evidence: Terminal styling logic is localized in source/index.js and string helpers in source/utilities.js.
Tests are grouped by behavior in test/chalk.js, test/level.js, test/instance.js, test/visible.js, and type assertions in source/index.test-d.ts.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: Related behavior is easy to find and modify.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Seams, substitution, and dependency inversion
evidence: `new Chalk({level})` creates isolated instances for tests and consumers.
Vendored supports-color is imported through package imports.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: Useful seams exist for color level behavior, though there is no broad DI/port abstraction because the package is intentionally small.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Hermetic, offline, and isolated testability
evidence: AVA tests run against local source and subprocess fixtures.
No test evidence requires network services or secrets.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: After dependency installation, the self-correction lane is local and hermetic.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Side-effect isolation and external-effect sinks
evidence: The meaningful side effect is terminal/stdout styling; tests assert strings directly and subprocess stdout for fixture behavior.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: No external effects exist; stdout/stderr behavior is captured enough for this topology.

axis_b_adaptability.name: State evolution and consequence verification
evidence: Tests mutate chalk.level and restore it around assertions.
Consequences are verified as returned strings or subprocess stdout.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: State is lightweight and local; no migration/reset lifecycle is needed.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Architecture boundary enforceability
evidence: XO is configured and CI enforces npm test.
No architecture-specific import boundary sensor was detected.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: General linting exists, but architecture boundaries are mostly implicit.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Complexity, size, and navigability thresholds
evidence: The repo is small with a short source tree and XO enabled.
No large generated application surface or multi-service topology was detected.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: Navigability is strong for an agent context window.

axis_b_adaptability.name: Inner-loop speed and repeatability
evidence: `npm test` provides one local validation command matching CI.
No services, ports, database resets, or remote state are needed.
axis_b_adaptability.notes: The edit-to-feedback loop should be repeatable once dependencies are installed.

scenario_probes.name: Library API behavior loop
scenario_probes.supported_interaction: Import chalk/Chalk and call public styling functions in AVA tests.
scenario_probes.expected_observable_consequence: Returned ANSI-coded strings or plain strings match expected values.
scenario_probes.reset_cleanup_path: No persistent state; tests reset chalk.level where mutated.
scenario_probes.what_agent_would_infer: Which subset of npm test is fastest for a scoped change.
scenario_probes.highest_leverage_missing_sensor: Harness quick/proof verbs that wrap the existing test lanes.

scenario_probes.name: Type contract loop
scenario_probes.supported_interaction: Run tsd against type assertion file.
scenario_probes.deterministic_verdict: npm test or npx tsd after install
scenario_probes.what_agent_would_infer: Whether tsd alone is an acceptable fast lane.
scenario_probes.highest_leverage_missing_sensor: Harness command exposing typecheck as a named verb or part of proof.

scenario_probes.name: Terminal support subprocess loop
scenario_probes.supported_interaction: AVA starts a Node subprocess fixture and observes stdout.
scenario_probes.expected_observable_consequence: Fixture stdout exactly equals expected color/no-color string.
scenario_probes.what_agent_would_infer: No harness-native artifact captures the observed stdout separately.
scenario_probes.highest_leverage_missing_sensor: Harness proof verb that records npm test output and coverage artifact paths.
